name: Philia Frederiki Bessarion
original_name: フィリア・フリデリキ・ベッサリオン
source: A prince forced to cross-dress so that he doesn't interfere with the line of succession. He is a strong warrior, but he has more brawn than brains. He is the only hero of story that doesn't cross-dress by choice.
translation: A prince forced to cross-dress so that he doesn't interfere with the line of succession. He is a strong warrior, but he has more brawn than brains. He is the only hero of story that doesn't cross-dress by choice.
